selection_basis.reported_pair_result: authoritative/native outputs byte-identical for every stage executed in both control and provenance-instrumented modes; only run-local CAL receipt paths differed
selection_basis.rule: Freeze the reported candidate commitments exactly before any fresh/context-free reconstruction attempt. Reconstruction must recover the presented manifest bytes and recompute/compare them to these fixed roots.

next_gate.consumer_requirement: Use a fresh/context-free consumer that did not create the paired run packages. Provide the frozen provenance specification/schema authority, this expected-root record, the four run package/manifest paths, and ordinary artifact locators. Do not provide expected semantic outputs beyond what is required to identify the frozen packages.
next_gate.success_condition: For each case, the recovered RunManifest bytes recompute to the fixed expected root; every reconstruction-required artifact is recovered and digest-verified; every present-stage attestation schema/digest validates; all artifact links and authority references resolve unambiguously; reconstruction status is reconstructable.
next_gate.failure_rule: Preserve any root mismatch, missing bytes, missing locator, invalid attestation, unresolved authority, ambiguous alias/link, schema failure, or other reconstruction gap. Do not move the expected root or repair the presented package after exposure.

alias_boundary.known_prior_observation: The prior RC1 terminal reconstruction reported four metadata aliases and one authority alias. The local paired-execution report reproduced those rows from the private RC1 receipt without schema modification.
alias_boundary.rule_for_this_gate: Do not normalize candidate provenance schemas before this reconstruction. If any alias ambiguity prevents unique reconstruction, preserve it as a falsifier.
